topic: Write a Personal Sports Story(写一篇个人运动故事)
genre: 记叙 / 个人故事(personal narrative:how you got started, how you felt, what you achieved)
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 3 Writing a sports story:为运动爱好者网站写一篇能激励读者的个人运动故事(如何开始、感受、为提高所做的努力、未来目标)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,一个运动爱好者网站正在征集能激励读者的个人运动故事。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,内容包括:① 你做的是什么运动、当初是怎么开始的;② 你对这项运动的感受;③ 你为提高所做的努力,以及未来的目标。注意:试着用上不定式(如 a sport to enjoy / too tired to give up / trained hard enough to win)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. A website for sports lovers is collecting personal stories to inspire its readers. Write a short passage (about 100 words) including: 1) what sport you do and how you got started; 2) how you feel about it; 3) what you have done to improve and your goal for the future. Try to use to-infinitives (e.g. a sport to enjoy, too tired to give up, trained hard enough to win).
points: 如何开始(When I was younger… / I never thought I'd…)
你的感受(Before I knew it, I had fallen in love with…)
为提高所做的努力 + 用上不定式(I trained hard enough to…)
未来目标(My ultimate goal is to…)
model_essay: When I was younger, I never thought I would be a runner. I had asthma, and even one lap was too hard for me to finish. Then a doctor told me that gentle exercise might make my lungs stronger, so I joined a small club. Before I knew it, I had fallen in love with running. I got up early every day to train, and slowly I grew strong enough to enter real races. Last month I won a medal at our city race. My ultimate goal is to run a marathon. If you feel too weak to start, please don't give up!
model_translation: 小时候,我从没想过自己会成为一名跑者。我有哮喘,连跑一圈对我来说都太难。后来一位医生告诉我,适度锻炼也许能让肺更强健,于是我加入了一个小俱乐部。不知不觉间,我爱上了跑步。我每天早起训练,慢慢变得足够强壮,能参加真正的比赛。上个月我在城市赛中赢得了一枚奖牌。我的最终目标是跑一次马拉松。如果你觉得自己太弱、迈不开第一步,请千万别放弃!

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:如何开始 / 你的感受 / 努力与未来目标
按'开始—感受—努力—目标'顺序展开、句句相关、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、恰当运用不定式(定语/结果/目的)、语法基本无误

required_structure: 开始 When I was younger, I never thought I would…
感受 Before I knew it, I had fallen in love with…
努力 I got up early to train and grew strong enough to…
目标 My ultimate goal is to…
key_expressions: I never thought I would be a runner.
Even one lap was too hard for me to finish.
I grew strong enough to enter real races.
My ultimate goal is to run a marathon.

high_sentences: When I was younger, I never thought I would be a runner.
Even one lap was too hard for me to finish.
I got up early every day to train, and slowly I grew strong enough to enter real races.
My ultimate goal is to run a marathon.

error_pairs.wrong: It was too hard to me to finish.
error_pairs.correct: It was too hard for me to finish.
error_pairs.note: too…to 结构中动作者用 for sb,不用 to sb。

error_pairs.wrong: I was strong enough win the race.
error_pairs.correct: I was strong enough to win the race.
error_pairs.note: enough to do 中 to 不能省略。

error_pairs.wrong: I got up early to training.
error_pairs.correct: I got up early to train.
error_pairs.note: 表目的用 to do(动词原形),不用 to + -ing。

paragraph_template:
【个人运动故事结构】
第1-2句 如何开始:When I was younger, I never thought I would…
第3-4句 感受:Before I knew it, I had fallen in love with…
第5-6句 努力:I got up early to train and grew strong enough to…
第7句 目标 + 鼓励:My ultimate goal is to… If you feel too weak to start, don't give up!
